test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What paradox is presented in the passage?

options.text: Choice leads control but also exhaustion
Following more influencers Less data brings more security

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paradox in the passage is that **freedom of choice**, which is usually seen as positive, can also create **stress and exhaustion** when options become excessive.
 
• It highlights the irony that **abundance** can actually make people feel less free, as they struggle with “decision fatigue.”
 
• Although choices give a sense of control, algorithms subtly limit exposure, adding to the paradox of control versus manipulation.
 
• Thus, the correct paradox is: **Choice leads to control but also exhaustion.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: “Technology helps only the rich”** – Not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Option 3: “More apps mean less productivity”** – Too narrow and not the central paradox.
 
• **Option 4: “Following more influencers Less data brings more security”** – Irrelevant to the context of the passage.
